events.title: Hella Fitzgerald feat.Lilan Kane
events.description: Keys Jazz Bistro presents Hella Fitzgerald for a rare, one-night-only appearance in the heart of North Beach. Led by vocalist and bandleader Lilan Kane, the Bay Area collective brings its signature blend of sophistication, groove, and spontaneity to an evening spanning soul, jazz, funk, R&B, and reimagined classics.
